rules: Pass a reactive object to :model. FormItem prop selects its field path; supported controls receive value/update bindings automatically, without a second v-model.
disabled and readonly are inherited by supported form controls; explicit control props override inherited values.
Use Button html-type=submit. The submit event contains { valid }; save only when valid is true. Use html-type=reset to reset fields and validation.
reset clears registered field values and validation; it does not restore an original model snapshot. Keep a separate snapshot when implementing cancel/revert.
Use inside Form. prop is a model field path, not its current value. A label alone does not bind a field.
type controls semantic appearance; htmlType controls native submit/reset/button behavior. Do not use type=submit.

Button.icon takes IconType[] data imported from kui-icons: import { Search } from 'kui-icons'; use <Button :icon="Search" /> in Vue templates or <Button icon={Search} /> in TSX. Never pass h(Icon, ...), a VNode, a component function, or an icon-name string to icon. Custom rendered content belongs in the default slot. Input prefix/suffix slots are not the Button.icon API.
Use v-model to control visibility.
The ok event does not automatically close the modal. Validate and save first, then set the bound visibility to false. loading prevents closing while a save is pending.
Pass columns and data explicitly. For remote paging, fetch data and total on page changes; Table does not fetch your backend automatically.
Pages are one-based. Use v-model:page and v-model:pageSize, not default v-model. change emits (page, pageSize).
Use default v-model for selection and v-model:openKeys with arrays. Use inlineCollapsed in inline mode; preserve expanded keys when implementing collapse controls.
Provides locale, size, theme and shape to descendants. Explicit component props take priority. Locale objects are imported from kui-vue/locale/<locale>.
Bind the selected value with v-model. When multiple is true, use an array of values. Consult examples before enabling virtual scrolling.
Default v-model is boolean. value-type=string or number changes the value type; keep the bound ref type consistent.
Use default v-model outside FormItem. Inside a bound FormItem, prefer Form model binding.
compact joins adjacent controls. Vertical compact layout supports Button groups; it is not a general-purpose vertical form layout.
The default slot contains the trigger; the overlay slot contains popup content. React uses children and the overlay prop for these roles.
Default v-model binds the selected value; range modes support a range array. startDate/endDate bindings are an alternative. Do not assume one generic binding shape across all modes.
The change event reports the selected date value and formatted text. Check valueType and mode and handle clearing explicitly.
checked controls check state and value identifies a grouped item; do not conflate value, label and checked. Read the emitted event type before migrating to React.
The default slot provides the trigger and overlay provides popup content. Use v-model:open when two-way visibility synchronization is desired.
The shared Popup manages nested layers; avoid a second document-click closer around nested selector popups.
